expectations.text: Session 1: the AI asks "Has this workflow been built yet, even if you haven't tested it?" (no Why or Not sure? line); after "yes" it says "This workflow is built but isn't running yet, so the next step is to finish it. Say 'run the test skill'."
expectations.evidence: The question never appears. The first AI turn lists three options (Go to Build / Redo requirements / Map a different workflow) and recommends "run the build skill". After "yes" the AI acts as Build: it shows a context check table (C1–C3) and a skill build plan. The required message and "Say 'run the test skill'" never appear.

expectations.text: Session 1 never tells the student to say 'continue my workflow'
expectations.evidence: The phrase 'continue my workflow' does not appear anywhere in the Session 1 transcript. The AI tells the student to say "run the build skill" and "run the scaffolding-registry skill".

expectations.text: Session 2: after "no", the re-run starts (the opening, then prefill from the old file)
expectations.evidence: After "no" the AI says "OK, I've left everything as it is: no edit to the tone guide entry and no redo of Step 2" and points to "run the build skill". No re-run opening or prefill from the old file happens.

expectations.text: Session 3 (`readiness: not-ready`, round complete): "This workflow is built but isn't running yet, so the next step is to finish it. Say 'run the build skill'."; the R9-3 question is not asked
